description:
Translation files: segments exported as XLIFF 1.2 or HTML, translated outside the API (CAT tool, translator, Supertext's web app) and imported again; see docs/integration-guide.md → Translation files. Not versioned with the API. A job is plugin, reference (opaque: what the integration needs to find the item), sourceLanguage, targetLanguage and segments (key unique in the job, text, html flag). Export refuses with invalid_job: no jobs; a metadata field or key that is empty, blank (metadata) or contains U+0000–U+001F or U+007F; duplicate keys (blank segments count); a job whose segments are all blank. Blank segments (only space, tab, CR, LF, FF) are left out. checksum: FNV-1a 32 bit (offset 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193) over the UTF-8 bytes of the packed segment (html-document.json: plain text escaped, line breaks as
; HTML as is), 8 lowercase hex digits. It only detects changed sources. XLIFF: exact layout as in the vectors; one per job (original = reference, product-name = plugin, datatype html, tool-id supertext-sdk); one per segment (id = key, datatype="plaintext" for plain text, extradata = checksum, xml:space="preserve"), only . Text is XML-escaped (& < > and CR as ; " also in attributes); characters XML 1.0 cannot hold are dropped. Plain text: CR LF and CR become LF. HTML segments become text and inline codes: a start tag with its matching end tag (same name, properly nested; not a void element: area base br col embed hr img input link meta param source track wbr; not self-closing) becomes /, every other tag, comment and entity that XML can't hold (unknown named entities, numeric references to characters XML can't hold) a ; the code's content is the original markup. Ids count from 1 in order of appearance, an has its 's id. Known entities (amp lt gt quot apos nbsp, numeric) are decoded in text. HTML: the document HtmlDocument.build makes, with lang = source language and plus one per segment in the head; values HTML-escaped (& < > " '). read: more than MAX_FILE_CHARACTERS (10,000,000, the language's string length) → too_large. After a BOM and leading whitespace, a file starting with , or only whitespace and no codes; HTML: nothing or whitespace, for plain text nothing left as text); invalid_markup; else ok when the unit's checksum equals the current segment's checksum, source_changed otherwise (the integration decides). Text is set for ok and source_changed only. XLIFF target: is unwrapped; , , with an id 1–999999999 are codes; any other element makes it invalid_markup. Plain text segments: the target's text, any code → invalid_markup. HTML segments: text HTML-escaped (& < >), each code replaced by the current source's code with the same kind and id (the file's code content is ignored); invalid_markup if a code isn't in the current source, a bpt id is used twice, or ept/bpt don't pair and nest (dropped pairs and repeated ph are fine). HTML file, plain text segment: HtmlDocument.parse's plain text. HTML file, HTML segment: rebuilt from its tokens: text with < escaped as <; tags only with names the current source has, start tags only with attributes that tag name has in the source; href src action formaction poster cite xlink:href (and each URL in srcset) must be relative or http/https/mailto/tel after decoding entities and removing whitespace and control characters (an & before the first / ? # → unsafe); comments only if identical to one in the source; else invalid_markup. An HTML file imported untranslated gives the source text as ok.

exportXliff.name: plain and HTML segments, blank ones left out
exportXliff.out:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xliff version="1.2" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:xliff:document:1.2">
  <file original="page:12" source-language="de-CH" target-language="fr-CH" datatype="html" product-name="Contao-Supertext-Translation" tool-id="supertext-sdk">
    <header>
      <tool tool-id="supertext-sdk" tool-name="Supertext SDK"/>
    </header>
    <body>
      <trans-unit id="title" datatype="plaintext" extradata="8bc37cbf" xml:space="preserve">
        <source>Käse & "Brot"</source>
      </trans-unit>
      <trans-unit id="body" extradata="72d77312" xml:space="preserve">
        <source><bpt id="1"><p></bpt>Ein <bpt id="2"><b></bpt>fetter<ept id="2"></b></ept> <bpt id="3"><a href="https://www.supertext.com/de?x=1&amp;y=2"></bpt>Link<ept id="3"></a></ept>.<ph id="4"><br></ph>Zeile 2<ept id="1"></p></ept></source>
      </trans-unit>
    </body>
  </file>
</xliff>
